keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «고양이가 높은 기둥 꼭대기에 올라간다(문제)» 와 «우리 할머니는 비밀 슈퍼히어로다(비밀)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (our cat climbs to the top of a tall pole) and the secret (Grandma is a secret superhero). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Our cat climbs to the top of a tall pole.
Grandma flies up and saves the cat. She is a secret superhero!

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: something you do not tell other people
One day, our cat climbs to the top of a tall pole.
a long, thin stick that stands up
things you wear on your eyes to see better
She catches the cat and lands softly.
a person with special powers who helps people
Then she goes back to her knitting.

qs.q: Why does Grandma fly up into the sky?
opts: Our cat is at the top of a tall pole.
She wants to see the clouds.
Her glasses fall into the sky.
evs: One day, our cat climbs to the top of a tall pole.
My grandma looks like a normal grandma.
Then she goes back to her knitting.
"Grandma, you are a superhero!" I shout.
why: 고양이가 높은 기둥 꼭대기에 올라가서, 할머니가 날아올라 구해 줘요.
Our cat climbs to the top of a tall pole, so Grandma flies up to save it.

qs.q: "My grandma is a secret superhero!" What does "secret" mean here?
opts: Other people do not know it.
evs: She catches the cat and lands softly.
My grandma looks like a normal grandma.
She winks. "Shh! Do not tell anyone."
why: 할머니가 «아무한테도 말하지 마» 라고 해요. «secret» 은 다른 사람은 모르는 것이라는 뜻이에요.
Grandma says, "Do not tell anyone." A secret is something other people do not know.

qs.q: How do we know Grandma is not a normal grandma?
qs.qko: 할머니가 평범한 할머니가 아니라는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: She knits a big red scarf.
She flies into the sky and catches the cat.
She climbs the pole with a ladder.
evs: My grandma looks like a normal grandma.
Whoosh! She flies up into the sky!
She catches the cat and lands softly.
Then she goes back to her knitting.
why: 할머니가 하늘로 날아오르고(«She flies up into the sky!»), 고양이를 잡고 내려와요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Grandma flies up into the sky, and she catches the cat. You need both sentences.

ends: Grandma teaches me how to fly in secret.
할머니가 몰래 나에게 나는 법을 가르쳐 준다.
Super Grandma helps a lost puppy find its home.
슈퍼 할머니가 길 잃은 강아지의 집을 찾아 준다.

write.src: “I think <u>my grandma is brave</u> because <u>she saves our cat</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)

img.cover: High in the blue sky above a quiet neighborhood, Grandma, a small old woman with curly gray hair in a bun, wearing a purple cardigan and a long green skirt, flies like a superhero with one arm stretched forward, holding a fluffy orange cat with white paws safely in her other arm, while a young girl with a short black bob in a red T-shirt cheers from the ground.

scenes.1: In a backyard next to a very tall wooden pole with a fluffy orange cat with white paws sitting at the very top, Grandma, a small old woman with curly gray hair in a bun, wearing a purple cardigan and a long green skirt, takes off her round glasses and starts to lift off the ground, as a young girl with a short black bob in a red T-shirt stares with her mouth open.
scenes.2: In a cozy living room, Grandma, a small old woman with curly gray hair in a bun, wearing a purple cardigan and a long green skirt, sits in an armchair with a ball of red yarn and her knitting, winking and holding a finger to her lips, while a young girl with a short black bob in a red T-shirt points at her in surprise and a fluffy orange cat with white paws naps on her lap.

alt.1: Grandma takes off her glasses next to the tall pole.
alt.2: Grandma winks and goes back to her knitting.
alt.cover: Grandma flies in the sky holding the cat.
